node.statement: Setup and bookkeeping: let C=conv{p_w:w in W}, a_j=P_vj, a_j^+=max(a_j,0), a_j^-=max(-a_j,0), nu_v=sum_j a_j^-, H={j:d_j>a*tau}, and B={j:d_j<=a*tau}. From def-signed-idempotent, row v of P^2=P gives p_v=sum_j a_j p_j=sum_j a_j^+ p_j-sum_j a_j^- p_j; by lem-mass-split, sum_j a_j^+=1+nu_v. Also d,d_j>=0, H subset {j:d_j>0}, sigma_a<=sigma, C_a>=0, and for every x in C and every row k, ||x-p_k||_1<=2+4*delta by the row-geometry clause of def-signed-idempotent and convexity of C.
